entries.00c1d045fa67144a: A company engaged in home-delivery purchase and sale of used goods, recycling of small home appliances, and group homes for people with disabilities, among other businesses.
entries.11c470078b109b4e: Through the company's own website under the "NETOFF" brand, it accepts purchase applications, collects used books, CDs, DVDs, game software, branded goods, precious metals, figures and other items by parcel delivery, appraises and purchases them, and sells them through online secondhand bookstores and other channels. Sales for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥5,756 million.
entries.2b6015fe0f7add71: A Cambodian subsidiary sends out personnel, including technical intern trainees, to work in Japan. Its growth focus is on dispatches specialized in the welfare field to address the shortage of care workers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥172 million, and in the current period it sent out 127 technical intern trainees.
entries.467a86a9df4257c0: People with disabilities who use group homes
entries.4c4b6fed07ab37c6: Accepting orders over the internet, it collects used small home appliances such as personal computers and mobile phones by parcel delivery. It also offers paid options such as data erasure, and sells the collected devices to recycling businesses or sells them for reuse. Sales for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥2,694 million.
entries.74b34c3cd9722a72: This business operates group homes for people with intellectual and mental disabilities and sends personnel from Cambodia to Japan. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,958 million.
entries.7604dd98077c7523: This is a category not included in reportable segments. It has operated a microfinance business in Cambodia, but is proceeding with withdrawal from the overseas financial business; operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥3 million.
entries.84e0631068ee4cbf: Individual users who dispose of used small home appliances
entries.8bf055a46cc8c59a: Domestic businesses that accept technical intern trainees
entries.e10ef59762861376: It provides directly operated group homes for people with disabilities and supports their independence through shared-living assistance. It also works to expand employment opportunities, including operating Type B Continuous Employment Support facilities. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,785 million.
